observations: Washington LT Laremy Tunsil suffered a torn triceps during practice on 2026-08-08 and requires surgery.
The team confirmed an extended absence but has not published a full-season timetable.
Washington's stated replacement plan: Brandon Coleman to LT, Chris Paul at LG, Josh Conerly Jr. remaining at RT, Andrew Wylie as swing-tackle depth.
inferences: If isolated protection quality degrades (H3), depth of target, play-action/deep usage, and explosive-pass efficiency could fall.
If Washington adapts with quick game and redistributed protection (H2), target opportunity may hold better than target depth or explosive efficiency.
Opportunity and efficiency must be assessed separately; effects are likely opponent- and game-context dependent.

source_refs.note: Team confirmation of injury and replacement discussion.
